items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 97:1
items.html: The essence of the Tzelem is drawn and formed from the upper AVI, at the time when they are one Partzuf with Yeshsut. For the Tzelem is the phase of the reflected light that rises at the time of the coupling from below upward, and clothes the ten Sefirot of direct light. And at the time of the coupling, AVI and Yeshsut must be one Partzuf, and then Yeshsut is not considered by name, but AVI alone. (Item 119)
